title: pctools
description: Types of the pctools package; mise run pctools:codegen writes src/pctools/models.py from this file.

Failure.description: Why a command stopped, printed as one JSON line on stderr.

error.description: The lines the shell task printed, joined by newlines.

Result.description: One pc-doctor check: pass, fail (it saw the problem) or unknown (it could not look).

PcDoctorLine.description: One pc-doctor stdout line per check: the result contract every pc:doctor check shares (spec #729).

check.description: The check's name, such as bootstrap-plan.

detail.description: One sentence: what it saw, or why it could not look.

culprits.description: What failed, each named so it can be quoted: <kind>:<name> for a bootstrap entry.

items.description: What the check found that is not a failure, such as a waiting update: <source>:<name> <old> -> <new>.

PcKernelBaseline.description: The boot values of the five PC kernel settings spec #729 guards, by sysctl name (data/pc-kernel.json).

BootstrapId.description: What a bootstrap entry manages: its kind (file, service, ...) and name (a path, a unit).

BootstrapOrigin.description: Where a bootstrap entry was declared: the config environments of its file.

BootstrapPlanReport.description: What pc-doctor reads of mise bootstrap plan --json (mise 2026.11.8): every planned resource.

BootstrapStatusReport.description: What pc-doctor reads of mise bootstrap status --json (mise 2026.11.8): its files and services parts.

services.description: System services, such as the runner slot instances (#636).

BootstrapEntry.description: The fields pc-doctor reads from one entry of mise bootstrap plan or status --json (mise 2026.11.8).

action.description: noop, create, update, remove or unknown.

origin.description: Where it was declared; null for an entry no config file declares.

CdiSpecDirs.description: docker info --format '{{json .CDISpecDirs}}': Docker's CDI folders (#732), absolute so none reads as a find expression.

CdiMount.description: One mount of a CDI spec's container edits; pc-doctor's gpu line reads only the host side.

hostPath.description: The PC path bound into the container.

CdiContainerEdits.description: The container edits of a CDI spec or of one device in it: the mounts are what pc-doctor reads.

CdiDevice.description: One device of a CDI spec, such as nvidia.com/gpu=all's "all".

CdiSpec.description: What pc-doctor's gpu line reads of a CDI spec file (cdiVersion 0.7.0, written by nvidia-ctk cdi generate).

kind.description: The device kind, such as nvidia.com/gpu.

DockerContainer.description: The fields pc-doctor's privileged-containers line reads from one object of docker container inspect (Docker 29.9).

Id.description: The full 64-hex id, as docker ps --no-trunc lists it.

Name.description: The container's name with docker's leading slash, such as /web.

DockerConfig.description: The part of a container's Config pc-doctor reads: the image it was started from.

DockerHostConfig.description: The part of a container's HostConfig pc-doctor reads: whether it was started with --privileged.
